name: PostgreSQL Database Schema
description: PostgreSQL database initialization on port 5432. Provides a single idempotent SQL init script (init.sql) that creates the `tasks` table with columns: id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, description TEXT, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(). Includes a CHECK constraint on status enforcing ('pending', 'in_progress', 'done') and an automatic updated_at trigger function for defense-in-depth data integrity. This is a standalone schema definition with no application logic. The init script is executed on database initialization (e.g., Docker entrypoint mount to /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/). Connection is via DATABASE_URL environment variable on port 5432. Satisfies AC1.

fields.name: value
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp string with timezone offset, e.g. '2024-01-15T10:30:00+00:00'. When read via psycopg2, this is a timezone-aware datetime object.

validators.error_message: Timestamptz must be a valid ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone.

types.description: TIMESTAMPTZ column type. Stored in UTC by PostgreSQL regardless of session timezone. Maps to Python datetime.datetime (timezone-aware, tzinfo=UTC) via psycopg2. DEFAULT NOW() applies only on INSERT; updated_at is maintained by trigger on UPDATE.

types.name: TaskRow

fields.name: status
fields.description: Task status, VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'. Constrained by CHECK to ('pending', 'in_progress', 'done').

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Row creation timestamp. DEFAULT NOW() on INSERT, never modified after creation.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Last modification timestamp. DEFAULT NOW() on INSERT, automatically set to NOW() on UPDATE by trigger function update_updated_at_column().

functions.name: execute_init_script
functions.description: Executes the idempotent init.sql script against the target PostgreSQL database. The script performs: (1) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks with all specified columns, (2) adds CHECK constraint on status column for ('pending', 'in_progress', 'done'), (3) creates OR REPLACE the update_updated_at_column() trigger function, (4) creates the trigger on the tasks table IF NOT EXISTS. This function represents the database initialization entrypoint, typically invoked by Docker via /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql mount.

structured_side_effects.description: Connects to PostgreSQL via psycopg2 and executes read-only introspection queries against information_schema and pg_catalog.

invariants: The tasks table has exactly 6 columns: id, title, description, status, created_at, updated_at — no more, no fewer.
Column 'id' is SERIAL PRIMARY KEY (int4, auto-incrementing, unique, NOT NULL). Values are non-contiguous; gaps are expected and valid.
Column 'title' is VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL. Empty string '' is allowed by the schema but semantically discouraged (application-layer concern).
Column 'description' is TEXT with no NOT NULL constraint. NULL represents absence of a description.
Column 'status' is VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' with CHECK constraint enforcing value IN ('pending', 'in_progress', 'done').
Column 'created_at' is TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(). Set on INSERT, never modified after row creation.
Column 'updated_at' is TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(). Set on INSERT via DEFAULT; automatically updated to NOW() on every UPDATE via the update_updated_at_column() trigger.
The update_updated_at_column() trigger fires BEFORE UPDATE on each row, setting NEW.updated_at = NOW().
All TIMESTAMPTZ values are stored internally in UTC by PostgreSQL regardless of session timezone settings.
DEFAULT values (status='pending', created_at=NOW(), updated_at=NOW()) apply only on INSERT when the column is not explicitly provided.
The init.sql script is fully idempotent: re-execution does not fail and does not modify existing data.
psycopg2 type mapping: id -> int, title -> str, description -> Optional[str], status -> str, created_at -> datetime.datetime (tzinfo=UTC), updated_at -> datetime.datetime (tzinfo=UTC).
The init.sql file is under 300 lines per operating procedure standards.

data_access.rationale: The database schema component reads PostgreSQL system catalogs (information_schema, pg_catalog) during verification to introspect table structure, constraints, and triggers. It writes DDL to the INTERNAL-classified tasks table schema (table definition, CHECK constraint, trigger function, trigger binding). Task data stored in the tasks table is classified INTERNAL as it contains application-domain task metadata (titles, descriptions, statuses) with no PII. No user-identifying data is stored in the tasks table.

side_effects.rationale: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS defines the tasks table schema with all six columns. This is a one-time structural change to the database catalog.
CHECK constraint on tasks.status enforcing domain values ('pending', 'in_progress', 'done') ensures data integrity at the storage layer.
The update_updated_at_column() trigger function and its BEFORE UPDATE binding on the tasks table automatically maintain the updated_at timestamp, providing defense-in-depth for temporal consistency.
Read-only queries against information_schema.columns, information_schema.table_constraints, and pg_catalog.pg_trigger to verify schema correctness during contract testing.

authority.rationale: This component is the sole authoritative source for the tasks table DDL, including column definitions, data types, default values, the CHECK constraint on the status column, and the updated_at auto-update trigger. No other component may issue DDL against the tasks table. Application components (e.g., backend API) consume this schema as readers/writers of row data but do not own or modify the structural definition.
